patch_description: This uses a two-stage constrained diameter-packing strategy rather than directly optimizing a soft min/max ratio. First, several deterministic charged-particle relaxations maximize a sharp smooth approximation of the minimum squared separation while the configuration is repeatedly rescaled to fixed diameter. The best candidates are then polished as an explicit nonlinear feasibility problem: all pairwise distances must be at least one, all pairwise distances must be below a minimized diameter variable, and the centroid is fixed. When SciPy is available, SLSQP uses exact analytic constraint Jacobians to resolve the active contact graph more accurately than a pure soft-force objective. A NumPy-only relaxation fallback remains available.
